The SEC Just Proposed Two New Ways To Raise Crypto Capital

The SEC proposed Regulation Crypto Assets on August 18,
offering two exemptions from securities registration. A startup
exemption allows token offerings up to $5 million over four
years. A larger exemption covers up to $75 million annually with
ongoing financial disclosures.

The proposal also includes a conditional safe harbor that could
